en.name: Manchego
en.summary: Manchego is a pressed, aged sheep's-milk cheese from La Mancha, sold in wedges with the woven esparto pattern on the rind. Unopened and vacuum-packed it keeps 3–6 months in the fridge; once opened, 3–4 weeks. It freezes for 6 months, though it loses its sweetness.
en.pantry: Manchego is firm and dry enough to survive being served, but the cupboard is not where it lives. Take out the wedge about half an hour before eating — cold manchego tastes of very little — and put it back afterwards. Do not leave a cut wedge out overnight: the fat sweats out of the cut face and the surface dries into a rind you then have to trim away.
en.fridge: An unopened vacuum-packed wedge keeps 3–6 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, which is the published figure for unopened hard cheese and fits manchego exactly. Once opened, give it 3–4 weeks: wrap it in waxed paper inside a loose bag or box so it breathes without drying, and change the paper when it gets greasy. Keep it in a whole wedge and cut from it — grated or cubed manchego dries out in days. The black wax and the woven esparto pattern are not meant to be eaten, though the rind itself is not harmful. Raw-milk manchego is legal and common in Spain; as with any raw-milk cheese, pregnant and immunocompromised readers should choose a pasteurised one, although a long-matured hard cheese is a far lower Listeria risk than a fresh one.
en.freezer: Manchego freezes for 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F), but freezing turns it crumbly and dulls the sheepy sweetness you paid for. Do it only if you plan to cook with it, in a block rather than grated, double-wrapped so it does not take up freezer smells. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the timeline is about quality. Young manchego fresco and semicurado are moister and shorter-lived than this record assumes, so shade every figure down for those.
en.thawing: Thaw it wrapped in the fridge and use it cooked or grated. Never thaw cheese on the counter, and do not refreeze it.
spoilage: Fuzzy growth on the cut face that goes into the paste rather than sitting on it.
A slimy or wet cut surface where it should be dry.
An ammonia or sour smell instead of the usual lanolin-and-nut one.
A rancid, crayon-like taste from the fat.
tips: Buy a thick wedge rather than slices or cubes; it keeps far longer.
Waxed paper in a loose box, changed every few days.
Trim a good margin around any surface mould on a firm cheese, or discard it if it is moist.
Keep the rind for a stew or a stock rather than eating it.

faq.q: How long does manchego keep in the fridge?
faq.a: About 3–6 months unopened and vacuum-packed at 4 °C or below, and 3–4 weeks once opened.
Yes, 6 months at −18 °C, but it comes out crumbly and less sweet. Freeze it in a block for cooking.

faq.q: Can you eat the rind of manchego?
faq.a: It is not harmful, but the black wax and the esparto-weave surface are not meant to be eaten. Save the rind for a stew instead.

faq.q: Is raw-milk manchego safe during pregnancy?
faq.a: Choose a pasteurised one. A long-matured hard cheese is a far lower Listeria risk than a fresh cheese, but the usual advice for raw milk still applies.

zh.name: 曼徹格乳酪
zh.summary: 曼徹格是西班牙拉曼查地區的壓製熟成綿羊乳酪，外皮上有草編模的菱格紋。未開封真空包冷藏可放 3～6 個月；開封後 3～4 週。冷凍可放 6 個月，但那股羊奶的香甜會被壓掉。
zh.pantry: 曼徹格夠硬夠乾，撐過一餐上桌沒問題，但櫥櫃不是它的住處。要吃之前半小時左右拿出來回溫——冰的曼徹格幾乎沒有味道——吃完再冰回去。切開的楔形塊不要放整夜：切面會滲油、表面乾成一層皮，最後還得切掉。
zh.fridge: 未開封的真空包在 4 °C 以下可放 3～6 個月，這是「未開封硬質乳酪」的公告值，和曼徹格完全吻合。開封後請以 3～4 週為限：用蠟紙包好，放進不密封的袋子或盒子，讓它能呼吸又不至於乾裂，紙一沾油就換。整塊保留、要吃再切——刨絲或切丁的曼徹格幾天就乾掉。黑色的蠟和草編紋表面並不是拿來吃的，不過外皮本身無害。西班牙的生乳曼徹格合法而且常見；跟所有生乳乳酪一樣，孕婦與免疫力低下者請選巴氏殺菌款，雖然長期熟成的硬質乳酪的李斯特菌風險遠低於新鮮乳酪。
zh.freezer: 曼徹格在 −18 °C 下可放 6 個月，但冷凍會讓它變碎，也會把你花錢買的羊奶甜味壓鈍。只有打算入菜時才這樣做，整塊冷凍不要先刨絲，包兩層避免吸味。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，期限講的是品質。年輕的 fresco 與 semicurado 比這篇假設的更濕潤、更短命，所有數字都要往下修。
zh.thawing: 連包裝放冷藏解凍，解凍後加熱或刨絲使用。乳酪不要放室溫解凍，也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 切面長出的絨毛霉不只停在表面，而是往內部長。
本該乾燥的切面變得濕黏。
出現氨味或酸味，而不是原本的羊脂與堅果香。
脂肪產生油耗、蠟筆般的味道。
tips: 買厚塊，不要買切片或切丁，耐放得多。
蠟紙包、鬆蓋盒裝，每隔幾天換一次紙。
硬質乳酪表面長霉可以連周圍一起切掉；若質地偏濕就整塊丟棄。
外皮留著燉湯，不要直接吃。

faq.q: 曼徹格乳酪冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封真空包在 4 °C 以下約 3～6 個月，開封後約 3～4 週。
可以，−18 °C 下 6 個月，但會變碎、甜味變鈍。整塊冷凍並用於料理。

faq.q: 曼徹格的外皮可以吃嗎？
faq.a: 外皮本身無害，但黑蠟和草編紋表面不是給人吃的。建議留著燉湯。

faq.q: 懷孕可以吃生乳曼徹格嗎？
faq.a: 請選巴氏殺菌款。長期熟成的硬質乳酪風險遠低於新鮮乳酪，但生乳製品的一般建議仍然適用。
